_comment: The league's state: every path here lives in the private repo (private_repo) and is ignored and untracked by this public repo. scripts/state.py copies exactly these paths between the working tree and the private clone at .state/ (pull before a manual run, push after). Read only through modules/state_manifest.py. files: exact paths. dirs: a directory and everything below it. patterns: file names matched in ONE directory, not below it. excluded: paths the engine touches that are deliberately not state. public_exceptions: tracked files inside a manifest dir or pattern that stay public on purpose. Invariants: tests/test_state_manifest.py. Design: claude/SELF_RUNNING_DESIGN.md s.2 (P2, 2026-10-31).

files.what: daily player log pulled from Yahoo (update_fantasy_logs)
the honour roll and season results, updated weekly
who sits in an IL slot now (sync_transactions)
Yahoo projections and tags, the live file (fetch_playerlist)
every published line, for calibration (weekly build)
last issue's recap for the next draft (Step 10)
the league's lore (Nick's sittings; read for drafting only via output/lore_for_drafting.json)
which lore entries have been used

dirs.what: published keep chances, one file per week (newsletter_html_generator)
weekly PLAYERLIST snapshots and Step 6's point-in-time captures (the pinned durability prior is a public exception)
Player of the Week photos, supplied by Nick
past seasons' state, archived by start_new_season at the reset

patterns.name: live_lines_week*.json
patterns.what: live lines, including each week's .state.json (the week-opening tag baseline and seed)

patterns.name: live_lines_week*.html
patterns.what: each week's live-line page (week 1's two pages are public exceptions)

patterns.name: refresh_service.*
patterns.what: the refresh service's run log and console

excluded.why: Yahoo credentials: never state, never copied (also oauth2_backup.json, oauth2.backup_*.json, *.oauth, private.json)
an old migration archive that contains credentials
dry-run packets, 194 MB, holding old lore copies; Nick's call (STATUS task 37): left where it is, not opened
cached basketball-reference pages, re-fetched on demand
the integrity check's size baseline, machine-specific
rollup safety backups of public history (also *_BACKUP.xlsx)
an old backup folder outside the engine
staging for files a session could not delete
a staged audit copy, credentials excluded

public_exceptions.why: the pinned pre-season durability prior (league_config durability_prior.snapshot): fixed for the season, already public, read by the public CI's integrity check (Nick, 10-31)
week 1's live-line page, kept public as a showcase (Nick, 10-31)
the mid-week demo page, kept public as a showcase (Nick, 10-31)
